name: Sum of Powers Identity Disguise
description: Replaces the requirement for distinctness (Exact Cover) with the mathematically equivalent condition that the sum of 2^(x-1) over exactly k elements equals 2^k - 1. Models that fail to deduce this equivalence will implement a sum-tracking DFS which fails to prune duplicate selections early, resulting in a Time Limit Exceeded. Models that reason deeply will recognize the identity, map it back to Exact Cover, and use DLX or bitmask DFS with early pruning.
